description: This file provides utility functions for database interactions and data normalization within a backend system. It includes functions for constructing database connection URLs, establishing connections, processing role and competency data, and upserting records into a PostgreSQL database. The code also features regex-based string normalization for slugs and specific normalization for well-known role codes.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_database_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the database connection string from prioritized sources: a file, environment variable, or fallback files, following a specific precedence.

methods.name: get_conn()
methods.description: Establishes and returns a PostgreSQL database connection using the URL provided by get_database_url.

methods.name: str slugify(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to a URL-friendly slug by lowercasing, replacing special characters, and normalizing separators.

methods.name: str normalize_role_slug(name: str)
methods.description: Normalizes well-known role codes and names into standardized slugs, or falls back to slugify for general strings.

methods.name: int upsert_roles(conn, roles: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Upserts a dictionary of roles into the roles table, updating existing records based on id.

methods.name: int upsert_competencies(conn, competencies: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Upserts a dictionary of competencies into the competencies table, updating existing records based on id.

methods.name: upsert_role_competencies(conn, mappings)
methods.description: Upserts role-competency mappings into the role_competencies table.

methods.name: upsert_role_adjacency(conn, records)
methods.description: Upserts records into the role_adjacency table, including JSONB gap data.

methods.name: upsert_role_cards(conn, records)
methods.description: Upserts role card content into the role_cards table.

ctags.name: upsert_competencies
ctags.pattern: /^def upsert_competencies(conn, competencies: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]) -> int:$/

ctags.name: upsert_roles
ctags.pattern: /^def upsert_roles(conn, roles: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]) -> int:$/
